ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can find an optimal feed formula in massive datasets, but a scientist still has to visit the site to learn why a cow refuses to eat.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,800 animal scientists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 2,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 200 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $79,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace animal scientists, but it will reshape research. AI can handle genomic analysis, phenotype modeling, and literature mining, shifting people toward experimental design, interpretation, and industry application. Field observation of animal behavior and the ability to turn research into production practices remain especially difficult to replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI image recognition that supports body-condition and behavior assessment
Precision feeding and smart livestock data platforms
Machine learning that optimizes feed formulations and breeding selection
ai_s2_auto: Entry and statistical analysis of experimental data
ai_s3_list: Experimental design and scientific judgment: AI cannot decide how to assign samples or define measures.
Field observation and intuition: a visit is needed to determine whether anomalous data reflects husbandry or disease.
Industry application: turning conclusions from a paper into practices farmers are willing to use.
Ethics and animal-welfare oversight: people remain responsible for compliant experiments.
Cross-disciplinary collaboration: communicating clearly with veterinarians, companies, and farmers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means about half of this occupation's work involves desk tasks and data, including statistics, modeling, and literature, all areas where AI is strong.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate AI exposure does not mean high risk. The better AI handles data, the more the field needs scientists who understand operations and can translate findings into production. Research roles limited to statistical work face pressure, while professionals who combine science and industry gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study animal science, livestock production, or veterinary technology, build a strong undergraduate foundation, and join a laboratory early. In the AI era, combine statistics, genomics, and data modeling with hands-on livestock experience for the widest range of options.

Adopt AI analysis and genomic methods, shifting from running experiments toward designing them and interpreting data. Spend time at livestock operations to connect research with industry needs and strengthen both funding prospects and career opportunities.

With a life-science or agricultural background, start as a research assistant or in corporate R&D and focus on animal nutrition and data analysis. On your resume, explain the experiments you conducted and the production problems you solved; this is more persuasive than a long publication list alone.

Do not hire animal scientists based only on publication counts. Evaluate experimental design and examples of industry application. Candidates who use AI efficiently and willingly work at livestock operations deserve more resources.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Individual feed-intake records and formulation optimization

ai_s7_trends: Genomics and precision nutrition are becoming mainstream, accelerating data-driven breeding and animal care.
As smart livestock equipment spreads, scientists are moving from collecting data to interpreting it.
Rising standards for sustainable production and animal welfare are expanding research into sustainability.

body: Animal scientists study animal nutrition, genetics, reproduction, growth, and health. Through experiments and data analysis, they improve feeding and management practices to make livestock production more efficient, higher quality, and more sustainable.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从海量数据里找出饲料配方的最优解，但「这头牛为什么不吃料」，还得科学家去现场看。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年动物科学家在岗约 0.28 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.29 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.91 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代动物科学家，但会重构研究方式。基因组分析、表型数据建模、文献挖掘都能交给 AI，人的工作转向实验设计、结果解读与产业落地。真正难以替代的，是对动物行为的现场观察和把研究变成生产方案的能力。
ai_s2_accel: 基因组学与全基因组关联分析
AI 图像识别辅助体况与行为评估
精准饲喂与智能养殖数据平台
机器学习优化饲料配方与育种选择
ai_s2_auto: 实验数据的录入与统计分析
样品检测数据的自动归档
ai_s3_list: 实验设计与科学判断：样本怎么分、指标怎么定，AI 给不了决定。
现场观察与直觉：数据异常背后是饲养问题还是病，要到现场看。
产业落地能力：把论文里的结论变成农户愿意用的方案。
伦理与动物福利把关：实验怎么做才合规，责任在人。
跨学科协作：跟兽医、企业、农户把话讲明白。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在案头与数据端——统计、建模、文献，正是 AI 擅长的领域。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：AI 把数据活做得越好，越需要懂现场、能把数据翻译成生产的科学家。被挤压的是只会跑统计、不接地气的科研岗，产业复合型人才更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学动物科学、畜牧兽医，本科打基础，尽早进实验室。AI 时代把统计、基因组学、数据建模作为核心技能，再叠加养殖现场经验，路会很宽。
把 AI 分析工具和基因组学方法用起来，从「做实验」转向「设计实验 + 解读数据」。多跑养殖场，把科研跟产业需求接上，项目经费和职业空间都更大。
有生科或农学背景的，从科研助理或企业研发做起，重点补动物营养与数据分析。简历上写清「做过什么试验、解决过什么生产问题」比堆论文更有说服力。
招动物科学家别只看论文数量，要看「实验设计能力 + 产业落地案例」。能用 AI 提效、又愿意下养殖场的人，值得给更多资源。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 个体采食记录、配方优化

ai_s7_trends: 基因组学与精准营养成为主流，数据驱动的育种和饲养全面提速。
智能养殖设备普及，科学家从采数据转向看数据。
绿色养殖与动物福利要求提升，研究边界扩展到可持续性。

body: 动物科学家研究动物的营养、遗传、繁殖、生长与健康，通过实验与数据分析优化饲养与管理方案，提高畜牧生产的效率、质量与可持续性。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能从海量数据里找出饲料配方的最优解，但「这头牛为什么不吃料」，还得科学家去现场看。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can score a full test battery in ten minutes, but only a clinical expert can decide what those scores mean within this patient's history and how to explain them to the family.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Clinical Neuropsychologists is projected to rise from about 55,300 in 2024 to 57,700 in 2034, a net increase of about 2,400 jobs, with around 3,900 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $117,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Clinical Neuropsychologists. Assessment tools are only instruments; test selection, result interpretation, and diagnostic integration require clinical judgment. Communication with patients and families also depends on people. AI can accelerate scoring, organize data, and draft reports, but it cannot understand a person's cognitive condition in context.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of digital cognitive tests
Integrated analysis of brain imaging and cognitive data
ai_s2_auto: Organizing assessment data and comparing norms
ai_s3_list: Clinical interpretation: place data within the patient's history.
Diagnostic integration: synthesize information from multiple sources.
Communication and empathy: explain conclusions to families.
Test selection: match tools to each patient.
Professional ethics: accept responsibility for assessment results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure tier. AI clearly improves neuropsychological assessment efficiency but cannot replace the core work. Scoring and data organization become automated, and digital tests expand, while clinical interpretation, diagnostic integration, and patient communication still depend heavily on professional judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still requires strong tool skills. AI cognitive screening and digital tests can expand access, allowing specialists to serve more patients. Screening results are not diagnoses, and clinical review remains the specialist's responsibility.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A common path starts with a bachelor's degree in psychology, followed by graduate or doctoral study in clinical psychology or neuropsychology. Prepare for a long commitment involving doctoral training, internship, and licensure. Relevant roles are growing in the Chinese mainland but remain limited, so confirm a genuine interest in clinical work and research.

Adopt digital cognitive tests and AI-assisted tools to expand services such as older-adult cognitive assessment and rehabilitation evaluation. Develop deep expertise in one or two areas, such as dementia assessment, stroke rehabilitation, or child neuropsychology. A specialist reputation is the strongest career asset.

Professionals from clinical psychology or rehabilitation can transition into neuropsychology by adding systematic neuroscience and test-administration training. Chinese mainland roles concentrate in hospitals and rehabilitation organizations. Highlight hands-on assessment cases and report-writing skills in interviews.

Neuropsychology talent is scarce and takes years to develop. Retain professionals through teaching resources, research support, and clear job levels. Digital assessment tools improve service efficiency and preserve expert time for interpretation and communication.

ai_s7_trends: Population aging drives sustained growth in cognitive-disorder assessment demand.
Digital tests and AI tools expand access to assessment.
Assessment increasingly integrates rehabilitation, imaging, and multidisciplinary care.

body: Clinical Neuropsychologists use standardized neuropsychological tests to assess brain function and cognitive status. They diagnose cognitive disorders associated with brain injuries and neurological diseases, provide functional assessments and rehabilitation recommendations, and counsel patients and families.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can score a full test battery in ten minutes, but only a clinical expert can decide what those scores mean within this patient's history and how to explain them to the family.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能十分钟完成一套量表计分，但「这份成绩单在这个患者的病史里意味着什么、该怎么跟家属说」——只有临床专家能拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年临床神经心理学家在岗约 5.53 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.77 万人，净增约 0.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.76 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代临床神经心理学家：评估工具只是手段，测验选择、结果解读和诊断整合需要临床判断，面对患者和家属的沟通更是只有人能做。AI 能提效计分、整理数据和生成报告初稿，但「读懂一个人的认知状况」这件事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助认知筛查工具
脑影像与认知数据的融合分析
远程神经心理评估平台
ai_s2_auto: 评估数据整理与常模对照
档案与随访记录电子化
ai_s3_list: 临床解读：把数据放进病史里看。
诊断整合：多源信息综合判断。
沟通共情：把结论讲给家属听。
测验选择：因人而异的工具匹配。
职业伦理：评估结果的责任担当。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明神经心理评估是「AI 明显提效、但替代不了核心」的专业岗位：计分、数据整理被自动化，数字测验在普及，但临床解读、诊断整合和医患沟通依然高度依赖专业人员的判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低中分更要跟上工具：AI 认知筛查和数字测验能显著扩大服务覆盖面，会用这些工具的专家能服务更多患者；但别把筛查结果当诊断，临床把关永远是专家的责任。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路，本科读心理学，之后读临床或神经心理学硕士博士。要做好长线准备：博士加实习加执照，投入十几年是常态。国内对口岗位在增长但还不算多，先确认孩子是否真的热爱临床和科研。
把数字认知测验和 AI 辅助工具用起来，拓展老年认知评估、康复评估等应用场景。深耕一两个方向（痴呆评估、脑卒中康复、儿童神经心理），专家口碑是最大的职业资产。
临床心理和康复背景的可以转神经心理方向，补神经科学和量表施测的系统训练。国内岗位集中在医院和康复机构，面试时突出评估实操案例和报告能力。
神经心理人才稀缺，培养周期长，用「带教资源 + 科研支持 + 清晰的职级」留人。配数字评估工具提升服务效率，让专家把时间花在解读和沟通上。

ai_s7_trends: 老龄化推动认知障碍评估需求持续增长。
数字测验与 AI 工具提升评估可及性。
评估与康复、影像多学科融合加深。

body: 临床神经心理学家运用标准化神经心理测验评估大脑功能与认知状态，诊断脑损伤、神经疾病伴发的认知障碍，提供功能评估、康复建议与患者及家属咨询。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce ten nutritious recipes in three seconds, but only the cook at the stove knows the family's appetite today, each person's dietary restrictions, and the occasion.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 34,200 Cooks, Private Household were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 36,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,800 jobs. The occupation generates about 5,300 openings per year and had a median annual wage of about $44,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cooks, Private Household, but it will take over desktop tasks such as recipe search, nutrition calculations, and inventory management. The core of household cooking is personal care: remembering tastes, working with the season, and adapting in the moment. Those abilities develop at the stove, not through an algorithm. Prepared foods and automated cooking equipment will take some demand, but they cannot replace high-end family banquets and customized service.
ai_s2_accel: Smart recipe apps that recommend combinations based on dietary restrictions and tastes
Automated cooking equipment, including combination steam ovens and sous-vide cookers, that assists meal preparation
Fresh-food delivery that reduces shopping time
Short-video and content platforms that build a private cook's personal brand
ai_s2_auto: Digital ingredient inventory and shopping lists
Schedule management for cooking times and serving order
ai_s3_list: Flavor judgment: the palate and hands control seasoning, heat, and texture.
Adaptation: respond to unexpected guests or rescue a dish that went wrong.
Communication and trust: understand the employer and remember each person's preferences.
Presentation: make a family banquet feel thoughtfully prepared.
Health and judgment: balance nutrition and match the occasion.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means most of this occupation remains hands-on stove work. AI mainly automates information processing for recipes, nutrition, and inventory. People still adjust food to individual tastes, create for specific occasions, and provide trusted service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not guarantee security. Private cooks who use smart recipes, understand nutrition data, and market content are more sought after than those relying only on cooking craft. The strongest pressure falls on purely manual cooks who copy basic home recipes without understanding service.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Restaurant kitchens are not the only path into cooking. After learning the basics, pursue private cooking or household nutrition meals. Master home cooking and banquet dishes, then add nutrition and communication skills. Education is not the barrier; a portfolio and reputation matter more.

Develop a signature style and use recipe apps and nutrition tools to work efficiently. If possible, create short videos to build a private-cook brand. High-end banquet clients pay more readily for a recognized individual chef.

If you enjoy cooking and want to change careers, test the market with weekend bookings. Build examples covering family banquets, dietary restrictions, and large gatherings. Your resume should describe the household types served, party sizes, and signature cuisines, which matter more than certificates.

Households hiring a private cook should evaluate more than a tasting. Sanitation habits, communication, and adaptability matter. Reasonable work boundaries and respect retain workers more effectively than money alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Recommend recipes based on dietary restrictions and tastes
Precise temperature control for consistent meals
Search cooking methods from regional cuisines

ai_s7_trends: As smart recipes and automated cooking equipment spread, private cooking shifts from manual meal preparation toward customized design and nutrition management.
Demand for high-end family banquets and customized healthy meals is rising, while personal branding and content operations create a second growth path.
Standardized prepared foods reduce demand for basic cooking services, while customized family banquets with personal care become harder to replace.

body: Cooks, Private Household provide personalized cooking services to families or specific clients. They prepare daily meals and family banquets, plan nutrition, and manage kitchens, customizing food to household tastes rather than following a restaurant's standardized service model.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can produce ten nutritious recipes in three seconds, but only the cook at the stove knows the family's appetite today, each person's dietary restrictions, and the occasion.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三秒钟给你十个营养食谱，但「这家人今天胃口如何、谁忌口、什么场合」，只有站在灶台前的厨师知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年私人家庭厨师在岗约 3.42 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.60 万人，净增约 0.18 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.53 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.45 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代私人家庭厨师，但会接管菜谱检索、营养计算和库存管理这些桌面活。家庭烹饪的核心是「为人服务的温度」：口味记忆、季节拿捏、临时应变，这些是在灶台上练出来的，不是算法能生成的。预制菜和自动烹饪设备会挤占一部分市场，但高端家宴和定制化服务恰恰是它们替代不了的。
ai_s2_accel: 智能菜谱 App 按忌口与口味推荐搭配
自动烹饪设备（蒸烤一体、低温慢煮）辅助出餐
生鲜电商配送降低采购跑腿成本
短视频/内容平台帮助私厨打造个人品牌
ai_s2_auto: 菜谱检索与创意灵感生成
食材库存与采购清单电子化
烹饪时间与上菜顺序的日程管理
ai_s3_list: 口味判断：咸淡、火候、口感，靠舌头和手。
临场应变：临时加人、菜做砸了怎么救场。
沟通与信任：懂雇主脾气、记住每个人的偏好。
审美摆盘：把家宴做出「被认真对待」的感觉。
健康与分寸：营养搭配和场合分寸拿捏。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的主体是「灶台上的手艺活」，AI 能自动化的主要是食谱、营养、库存这类信息处理；而按口味调校、按场合创作、按信任服务，依然是人不可替代的部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高枕无忧：会用智能菜谱、懂营养数据、能做内容运营的私厨，比纯靠手艺的更吃香。真正被挤压的是「只会照搬家常做法、不懂服务」的纯体力型厨师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想做厨师不一定要挤餐厅后厨，学完基础后可以往私厨、家庭营养餐方向走，先学透家常菜和宴客菜，再补营养和沟通。学历不是门槛，作品和口碑才是。
把拿手菜做出个人特色，学会用菜谱 App 和营养工具提效；有条件就拍短视频积累私厨品牌，高端家宴客户更愿意为「有名有姓的厨师」买单。
喜欢做饭想转行，先用周末接单试水，积累「家宴 + 忌口 + 大型聚餐」的案例；简历里写明你服务过的家庭类型、翻台规模和拿手菜系，比证书更管用。
家庭雇私厨别只看试菜，要看卫生习惯、沟通方式和适应力；留人靠的是合理的工作边界和尊重，不是单纯加钱。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 热量与营养素自动核算

ai_s7_trends: 智能菜谱与自动烹饪设备普及，私厨从「体力做饭」转向「定制设计 + 营养管理」。
高端家宴、健康定制餐需求增长，个人品牌与内容运营成为私厨第二曲线。
标准化预制菜挤压基础代厨，但「有温度的家宴定制」壁垒反而更牢固。

body: 私人家庭厨师为家庭或特定客户提供私人化的烹饪服务，负责日常三餐、家宴筹备、营养搭配与厨房管理，是区别于餐厅标准化出餐的「按口味定制」型厨师岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI-assisted image review can support screening, but officers still make on-site judgments and enforcement decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 698,800 customs officers employed in 2024, projected to rise to 720,800 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 22,000 jobs, with about 53,700 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $76,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace customs officers, but it will reduce standardized inspections. AI image review and risk models accelerate routine screening, shifting officers from reading images toward assessing risk, handling violations, and coordinating enforcement. Roles limited to following standard instructions face pressure, while officers who analyze and act become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Risk assessment: people evaluate warning signs.
On-site response: people handle violations.
Applying regulations: people determine which rules fit the situation.
Coordinated enforcement: people align agency actions.
Emergency response: people control unexpected events.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation at moderate AI exposure in enforcement work. AI accelerates standardized inspections, while on-site response still requires people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. AI replaces routine image review, not the job of assessing risk and taking enforcement action. Officers who analyze and act become scarcer as productivity rises. Those who only follow standard instructions face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you start in law or international trade, practice regulatory analysis and risk assessment. Routine inspection work is shrinking in the AI era, so build response skills early.
Move from reading images to risk assessment + enforcement response. Learn how risk models work.
Highlight examination results and port-of-entry experience. Specify the operations you handled. Public-service roles value reliability and integrity.
Look beyond education when hiring. Evaluate enforcement judgment. High performers who can handle incidents deserve stronger assignments.

ai_s7_trends: AI image review becomes widespread
Fewer standardized roles
Risk-assessment skills become more sought after

body: Customs And Border Protection Officers enforce port-of-entry regulation and border controls. They coordinate inspections, image review, and enforcement responses, applying regulations and risk methods to protect border security and trade order.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI-assisted image review can support screening, but officers still make on-site judgments and enforcement decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 智能审图能辅助筛查，但现场判断和执法处置，还是官员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年海关官在岗约 69.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 72.08 万人，净增约 2.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.37 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代海关官员，但会压缩标准查验。智能审图与风险模型把常规过机提速，官员从「看图像」挪向「判风险、处置违规、协同执法」。真正被挤掉的是只抄标准的，有研判力能处置的更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 风险研判：疑点靠人判。
现场处置：违规靠人处。
法规适用：情形靠人定。
协同执法：配合靠人对。
应急能力：突发靠人控。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的执法区——标准查验被加速，但现场处置还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「看标准图像」动作，不是「判风险处置」的岗位。有研判力、能执法的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会抄标准的官员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 法学/国贸起步多练法规和研判，AI 时代纯查验在缩，早点练处置。
从「看图像」升级成「做研判 + 处置」，学风险模型。
突出招考和口岸经验，写清跟过哪些业务。公职看重稳和正。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有执法脑子。能处置的骨干值得给好岗。

ai_s7_trends: 智能审图普及
标准岗缩
有研判力更抢手

body: 海关与边境保护官员执行口岸监管与边境管控，统筹查验、审图与处置，运用法规与风险手段维护国门安全与贸易秩序。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 智能审图能辅助筛查，但现场判断和执法处置，还是官员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate virtual dancers and assist with choreography, but it cannot replace the sweat at curtain call or the audience's applause.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 12,300 Dancers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 12,900 by 2034. That represents about 600 net new jobs and roughly 1,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $51,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dancers, but it will change the industry's structure. AI and digital tools assist with choreography, analyze rehearsal videos, and create virtual dancers. Dancers are moving from performance-only roles toward performance + creation + teaching. Machines cannot reproduce physical control, stage presence, or emotional expression. Dancers who create and teach gain more stable career options.
ai_s2_accel: More virtual dancers in performances and livestreams
Growth of digital stages and holographic performances
ai_s2_auto: Automated movement analysis of rehearsal videos
Digital performance scheduling and costume management
Virtual dancers for previews and advertising
ai_s3_list: Physical control and technique: years of foundational training cannot be replicated by machines.
Stage presence: emotion, eye contact, and audience impact come alive in person.
Creation and improvisation: algorithms cannot supply a dancer's choreographic inspiration or live response.
Ensemble coordination: dancers build shared timing and breath through practice.
Career resilience: passion sustains dancers through injuries, setbacks, and long training cycles.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. AI tools now assist parts of rehearsal and creation, including choreography drafts and movement analysis.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. AI supports parts of the process, while live performance, emotional expression, and audience connection grow more important. Standardized performances face the most pressure. Dancers who create and teach are more resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Consider a professional dance academy or arts-school route, with equal attention to foundational training and academic study. Develop multiple dance styles and creative skills instead of mastering only one routine.

Build choreography, teaching, and social-media skills, and learn to use AI tools in the creative process. Move from performance-only work toward performance + creation + teaching. A dance-teaching credential can extend your career.

If you have dance training, start through ensemble or training-school work. Without that foundation, consider adult dance instruction or fitness-oriented roles. A dancer's peak performance period is limited, so plan the next stage early.
Do not evaluate Dancers on technique alone. Look for stage presence and creative potential. The rarest combination is someone who can perform, choreograph, teach, and adapt to new formats.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Distribute work and grow an audience

ai_s7_trends: AI-assisted choreography and movement analysis are becoming common. Dancers are moving from performance-only work toward performance + creation + teaching, making creativity a competitive advantage.
Virtual dancers and digital stages are expanding. Live human performance becomes more distinctive, while cultural-tourism productions create additional demand.
Online dance instruction and creator media are expanding, giving Dancers more income sources beyond individual performances.

body: Dancers perform through physical movement, rhythm, and expression. They complete technique training, rehearse productions, execute choreography, and portray roles in theatrical and commercial performances. The body is their primary medium in the performing arts.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate virtual dancers and assist with choreography, but it cannot replace the sweat at curtain call or the audience's applause.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成虚拟舞者、帮忙编舞，但谢幕时那身汗水和观众的掌声，机器替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年舞者在岗约 1.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.29 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代舞者，但会改变行业生态。编舞辅助、练习视频分析、虚拟舞者正被 AI 和工具带起来，舞者从「纯表演」转向「表演+创作+教学」——身体的控制、舞台的表现力和情感表达，是机器替代不了的。会创作、能教学的舞者反而更稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 动作捕捉辅助教学
虚拟舞者在演出与直播中增多
数字舞台与全息演出兴起
线上舞蹈教学平台扩张
ai_s2_auto: 编舞初稿 AI 辅助生成
练习视频自动动作分析
演出排期与服装管理数字化
虚拟舞者用于预演与广告
ai_s3_list: 身体控制与技术：基本功十年磨一剑，机器学不来。
舞台表现力：情绪、眼神、感染力，现场才有。
创作与即兴：编舞灵感和即兴发挥，算法给不了。
团队默契：群舞的呼吸一致，靠人练出来。
职业韧性：伤病、落差、坚持，靠热爱扛住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半的排练与创作环节正被 AI 工具辅助——编舞初稿、动作分析，AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 参与的是「辅助」环节，留下的是「舞台」环节——现场表演、情感表达和观众连接反而更重要。真正被压缩的是标准化演出，有创作力、能教学的舞者更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走专业舞蹈院校或艺校路线，重视基训与文化课。把多舞种和创作能力都练起来，别只练一支舞。
把编创、教学和自媒体运营做起来，学会用 AI 工具辅助创作。从「纯表演」升级为「表演+创作+教学」，考舞蹈教师资格，延长职业寿命。
有舞蹈基础可从群演或培训机构切入，无基础走成人舞蹈教学或健身方向。职业黄金期有限，早做转型规划。
招舞者别只看技术，要看表现力和创作潜力。能跳、能编、能教、又能适应新业态的舞者，是最稀缺的组合。

ai_s7_trends: AI 编舞与动作分析普及，舞者从「纯表演」转向「表演+创作+教学」，创作力成为竞争力。
虚拟舞者与数字舞台兴起，真人舞台表演反而更稀缺，文旅演出需求增长。
线上舞蹈教学与自媒体扩张，舞者的收入来源从单一演出走向多元。

body: 舞者通过肢体动作、节奏与表情进行舞台表演，包括完成基训、参与排练、按编舞执行演出，以及在剧目与商业演出中塑造角色，是演艺行业中以身体为表达媒介的舞台职业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能生成虚拟舞者、帮忙编舞，但谢幕时那身汗水和观众的掌声，机器替代不了。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Drones can survey a fire, but Firefighters still decide which wall could collapse, how to enter for a rescue, and where the safety limit lies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Firefighters is projected to rise from about 344,900 in 2024 to 356,700 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 11,800 jobs, with roughly 27,100 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $59,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Firefighters, but it will reduce the reconnaissance phase. Drones and sensors accelerate fireground awareness. Firefighters shift from observing conditions to structural judgment, entry rescue, hazardous-material response, and incident command. Standard reconnaissance faces the most pressure. People who judge conditions and save lives become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Structural judgment: people identify collapse risks.
Entry rescue: people choose the right moment.
Hazardous-material response: people control the risk.
Incident command: people coordinate the response.
Protection of life: people carry the responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate exposure range for emergency response. Sensing systems accelerate awareness, but people still enter fires and rescue victims.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. Systems replace the act of watching reconnaissance feeds, not structural judgment and rescue roles. Firefighters who judge conditions and save lives become scarcer as productivity rises. Feed-only reconnaissance roles face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with physical testing and emergency-response training. Practice teamwork and first aid. Pure reconnaissance is shrinking in the AI era, so develop judgment early.
Move from watching feeds to making decisions and conducting entry rescues. Learn hazardous-material response and pursue crew responsibility.
Highlight physical-test results and service history. State which emergencies you have handled. Fire services value steadiness and courage.
Do not select people on fitness alone. Test judgment as well. Firefighters who can lead rescues merit advancement.

ai_s7_trends: Sensing systems become widespread and shorten reconnaissance.
Structural judgment and rescue create opportunities.
Firefighters with strong response skills are in greater demand.

body: Firefighters respond to fires and emergencies. They suppress fires, search for and rescue victims, provide first aid, and protect lives and property (O*NET 33-2011.00).
career_ai_description_block.heading: Drones can survey a fire, but Firefighters still decide which wall could collapse, how to enter for a rescue, and where the safety limit lies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人机能侦察，但哪面墙要塌、怎么突入救人、红线在哪，还是消防员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年消防员在岗约 34.49 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 35.67 万人，净增约 1.18 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.71 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.95 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代消防员，但会压缩侦察段。无人机与传感器把火场感知提速，消防员从「看火势」挪向「结构判断、突入救人、危化处置、现场指挥」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准侦察的，会判断会救人的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 结构判断：坍塌靠人辨。
突入救人：时机靠人定。
危化处置：风险靠人控。
现场指挥：协同靠人调。
生命兜底：责任靠人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的救援区——感知系统已加速，但冲火场与救人还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「看侦察画面」动作，不是「结构判断与救人」的岗位。会判断、会救人的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会看画面的消防员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 体测+应急起步多练协作和急救，AI 时代纯侦察在缩，早点练判断。
从「看画面」升级成「做判断 + 突入救人」，学危化，争取班组。
突出体测和履历，写清跟过哪些险情。消防看重稳和勇。
选人别只看体能，要看有没有判断脑子。能救人的骨干，值得给职级。

ai_s7_trends: 感知系统普及，侦察段缩。
结构判断与救人带来机会。
会处置的消防员更抢手。

body: 消防员响应火警与救援，执行灭火、搜救与急救，保护生命与财产安全（O*NET 33-2011.00）。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 无人机能侦察，但哪面墙要塌、怎么突入救人、红线在哪，还是消防员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CRM can schedule follow-ups and AI can draft copy, but fundraisers still earn donor trust and tell stories that move people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 134,400 Fundraisers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 140,200 by 2034, adding about 5,800 jobs and producing roughly 10,200 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $66,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fundraisers, but it will accelerate outreach and writing. CRM, automated outreach, and generated copy speed up basic tasks. Fundraisers shift from mass messaging toward relationship development, storytelling, and major-donor engagement. Routine outreach faces pressure, while people who understand donors and communicate well gain value.
ai_s3_list: Relationship management: people cultivate trust.
Storytelling: people create emotional connection.
Major-donor engagement: people secure commitment.
Live events: people create the atmosphere.
Crisis communication: people exercise judgment and tact.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in a moderate AI-exposure area of outreach. Systems accelerate communication and writing, while relationship development and storytelling preserve a central human role.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Automation replaces basic outreach and template writing, not relationship development. Fundraisers who understand donors and tell compelling stories become scarcer as productivity rises. Workers limited to mass templates face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A communications or business background provides a useful start. Build writing and data skills in school because template writing is shrinking. Develop relationship skills early.
Move from mass outreach into donor development and storytelling. Learn CRM and forecasting, then pursue fundraising-management responsibility.
Emphasize fundraising and storytelling cases. Describe the institutions you have supported because employers value reliability and integrity.
Do not hire only for writing ability. Assess whether candidates understand people and can develop relationships. Strong donor managers warrant performance-based rewards.

ai_s7_trends: CRM and AI improve productivity and reduce basic outreach work.
Digital crowdfunding expands opportunities.
Fundraisers with strong relationship and storytelling skills remain scarce.

body: Fundraisers plan campaigns for nonprofits, universities, and cultural institutions. They develop donor relationships, write proposals and stories, organize events and digital crowdfunding, and use CRM to improve retention.
career_ai_description_block.heading: CRM can schedule follow-ups and AI can draft copy, but fundraisers still earn donor trust and tell stories that move people.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CRM 能自动排跟进、AI 能出文案，但那位老捐方为什么信你、故事怎么讲进心，还是募资专员的嘴和心定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年募资专员在岗约 13.44 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.02 万人，净增约 0.58 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.65 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代募资专员，但会加速触达与文案。CRM、自动外联和生成式文案把低阶动作提速，专员从「群发」挪向「关系经营、故事讲述、大捐方动员」。真正被挤掉的是低阶触达，懂人能讲的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 关系经营：信任靠人养。
故事讲述：共情靠人。
大捐动员：临门靠人。
现场活动：氛围靠人。
危机沟通：分寸靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的触达区——外联与文案被系统加速，但经营与讲述还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「低阶触达与套模板文案」动作，不是「关系经营」的岗位。懂人、能讲的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会群发模板的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 传播/商科打底，在校多练写作与数据。AI 时代模板文案在缩，早点练关系。
从「群发」升级成「做 donor 经营 + 故事」，学 CRM 与预测，争取当筹款经理。
突出筹款与故事案例，写清跟过哪些机构。机构看重稳和诚。
选人别只看会写，要看懂不懂人。能经营的募资，值得给高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: CRM 与 AI 提效，触达缩。
数字众筹扩机会。
懂经营会讲的更缺。

body: 募资专员为公益组织、高校或文化机构策划筹款，开发维护捐方、撰写提案与故事、组织活动与数字众筹，运用 CRM 提升留存，是机构资源拓展的前端。
career_ai_description_block.heading: CRM 能自动排跟进、AI 能出文案，但那位老捐方为什么信你、故事怎么讲进心，还是募资专员的嘴和心定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate grinding parameters precisely and measure dimensions in fine detail, but an experienced worker must still judge from the sparks whether a wheel needs dressing or whether the next pass will burn the workpiece.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 70,100 machine tool setters, operators, and tenders for metal and plastic in 2024, projected to fall to 61,700 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 8,400 jobs, with roughly 5,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $45,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not immediately replace grinding and polishing machine operators, but it will reshape the job. CNC grinders, in-process measurement, and adaptive grinding are reducing purely repetitive work. Experienced workers who can set up machines, understand processes, and handle anomalies will remain valuable, while opportunities will shrink for operators limited to loading parts and pressing buttons.
ai_s2_accel: Adaptive grinding adjusts parameters to remaining stock in real time
AI detects grinding burns and chatter marks
CNC grinders change wheels automatically according to the program
Integrated production scheduling and grinder control
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of production records and reports
ai_s3_list: Spark judgment: infer grinding conditions from sparks and sound.
Anomaly handling: address burns, chatter marks, and fractures on site.
Wheel feel: judge dressing timing and depth of cut.
Precision control: give dimensions and finish their final confirmation.
Process experience: set up machines for high-mix, low-volume parts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places grinding work in a moderate AI exposure range. Data-driven tasks such as parameter setting, measurement, and scheduling are easy to automate, while shop-floor operation and anomaly judgment remain human strengths. The risk is less direct replacement by AI than displacement by CNC equipment, as opportunities decline for workers who cannot program and set up machines.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean immediate unemployment. Smart grinders still require people to load parts, monitor tools, and handle anomalies. Master CNC programming and in-process measurement to advance from operator to setup technician, improving both job stability and earnings.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a student who likes machinery and has steady hands, study CNC machining or mechatronics and begin as a grinder apprentice after graduation. Two years can be enough to become a capable setup technician. Do not study only conventional machining; include CNC programming.

Learn CNC grinder programming and in-process measurement, then move toward high-precision, mold, or aerospace components. Add knowledge of grinding wheels and coolant. Stronger process skills also raise your earnings ceiling.

A beginner can enter a factory as an apprentice, but choose one with CNC equipment and learn setup while working. Career changers with a mechanical background progress quickly. In interviews, emphasize precision awareness and learning ability rather than experience alone.

Experienced grinding workers are becoming scarce. Build talent through apprenticeships plus setup-skill allowances, and establish skill-based pay grades for technicians who can program. Include the availability of capable setup staff when calculating returns on smart equipment.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Measure dimensions in real time during machining

ai_s7_trends: As CNC and adaptive grinding spread, purely operational roles decline each year.
As high-precision manufacturing expands, grinding workers who can set up and program machines are in greater demand.
In-process measurement is being linked with quality data, making precision control increasingly data-driven.

body: Grinding, Lapping, Polishing, and Buffing Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders set up and operate grinders, lapping machines, and polishing machines to perform precision surface machining on metal, plastic, and other workpieces. They control dimensions and finish, conduct inspections, and maintain equipment.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate grinding parameters precisely and measure dimensions in fine detail, but an experienced worker must still judge from the sparks whether a wheel needs dressing or whether the next pass will burn the workpiece.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把磨削参数算得很准、把尺寸自动测得很细，但「砂轮该不该修、这一刀下去会不会烧伤」——这种火花里的判断，还得老师傅的眼睛来定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器工具铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 7.01 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.17 万人，岗位净减约 0.84 万个，年均产生约 0.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.52 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会立刻取代磨削抛光机操作工，但会改写这个岗位：数控磨床、在线测量、自适应磨削正在减少纯重复操作，真正留下的是会调机、懂工艺、能处理异常的老师傅。纯装夹按键的普通操作工，岗位空间会被压缩。
ai_s2_accel: 自适应磨削按余量实时调参
AI 检测磨削烧伤与振纹
数控磨床按程序自动换砂轮
ai_s2_auto: 磨削参数自动计算与设定
在线测量替代手动抽检
加工记录与报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 火花判断：从火花与声音判断磨削状态。
异常处置：烧伤、振纹、崩裂的现场处理。
砂轮手感：修整时机与吃刀量的把握。
精度把关：对尺寸与光洁度的最后确认。
工艺经验：多品种小批量工件的调机。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明磨削岗位属于「中等 AI 曝光」：参数、测量、排产这类数据化环节容易被自动化，现场操作与异常判断还是人的主场。风险不在「被 AI 顶替」，而在「被数控设备挤出」——不会编程调机的人，机会在变少。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于马上失业：智能磨床也得有人装夹、看刀、处理异常。把数控编程和在线测量用熟，从「操作工」升级成「调机工」，岗位反而更稳，收入也上一个台阶。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子喜欢机械、手又稳的，读数控加工或机电一体化方向，毕业进厂从磨床学徒起步，两年就能成调机熟手。别只学普通机加工，一定要带数控编程。
把数控磨床编程和在线测量学起来，往高精度、模具、航空零部件方向走；同时了解一点砂轮和冷却液知识，工艺能力上去了，收入天花板也跟着上去。
零基础可以进厂当学徒，但选有数控设备的工厂，边干边学调机；有机械基础的转行上手快，面试时强调你的精度意识和学习能力，比只谈经验有用。
磨削老师傅青黄不接，建议用「学徒制 + 调机技能津贴」自己培养，给会编程的技工设技能等级工资；智能设备投资回报要算上「会调机的人」这笔账。

ai_s7_trends: 数控与自适应磨削普及，纯操作岗逐年减少。
高精度制造扩张，会调机编程的磨削工更抢手。
在线测量与质量数据联动，精度管控靠数据说话。

body: 磨工是磨削、研磨、抛光机操作工负责设置和操作磨床、研磨机与抛光机，对金属、塑料等工件进行精密表面加工，控制尺寸与光洁度，并完成检测与设备维护。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can turn contract research into a checklist, but people must still sit at the bargaining table and decide whether both sides can accept a wage clause.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 65,400 labor relations specialists employed in 2024, projected to remain at about 65,400 in 2034, a net change of 0 jobs, with roughly 5,100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $93,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace labor relations specialists, but it will accelerate desk work. Once AI handles contract generation, clause research, and case summaries, specialists can focus on negotiation, mediation, and strategy. The scarce skill is finding consensus in conflict through both legal knowledge and human judgment.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted drafting of bargaining proposals and clauses
Automatic impact assessment of regulatory changes
ai_s2_auto: Automatic research and summaries of contract clauses and regulations
Template generation for collective agreements and employee handbooks
Structured archiving of labor dispute cases
Automatic aggregation and reporting of labor-management data
ai_s3_list: Negotiation: find consensus amid conflicting interests.
Mediation judgment: determine a fair resolution.
Organizational politics: navigate between management and labor.
Compliance tradeoffs: balance legality and feasibility.
Emotional stability: remain composed during conflict.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score indicates moderate AI exposure because text and research can be accelerated, while negotiation and mediation still depend on human judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure still requires caution. Templates and AI will absorb basic document work, leaving negotiation, mediation, and organizational judgment as the durable advantage. Specialists limited to drafting and filing contracts face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in human resources or law and practice negotiation while studying labor law. Coordination matters more in the AI era, so avoid becoming only a document operator.
Become proficient with AI drafting tools and gain practical negotiation and mediation experience. Moving from writing contracts to managing relationships creates a broader career path.
Highlight the contracts you have negotiated and disputes you have resolved. Demonstrated negotiation and compliance outcomes deserve priority.
Hire for coordination and resilience, not only knowledge of statutes. Specialists who can negotiate and mediate independently merit higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Stricter labor regulation sustains demand for compliance and dispute resolution.
More flexible work arrangements make employment relationships more complex.
Hybrid specialists who can negotiate and mediate become scarcer.

body: Labor relations specialists manage collective bargaining, labor contracts, workplace rules, dispute mediation, and compliance. They coordinate between management and employees or unions to keep employment relationships lawful, stable, and manageable.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can turn contract research into a checklist, but people must still sit at the bargaining table and decide whether both sides can accept a wage clause.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把合同条款检索成清单，但「这条涨薪双方接不接」，还得人坐到谈判桌前谈。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年劳动关系专员在岗约 6.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.54 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代劳动关系专员，但会加速案头工作。合同生成、条款检索、案例摘要交给 AI 后，专员从「写文本」挪向「做谈判、搞调解、定策略」。真正稀缺的是能在冲突里找共识、既懂法又懂人的协调者。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助起草谈判方案与条款
法规变动的自动影响评估
员工诉求的自动分类整理
ai_s2_auto: 合同条款与法规的自动检索摘要
集体合同与员工手册的模板生成
劳动争议案例的结构化归档
劳资数据的自动汇总与报表
ai_s3_list: 谈判能力：在利益冲突里找共识。
调解判断：纠纷怎么断公平。
组织政治：在资方劳方间周旋。
合规权衡：合法与可行的取舍。
情绪稳定：冲突里不崩。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——文本和检索能被加速，但谈判调解这类人际判断仍牢牢在人手里。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光也要警惕：基础文本岗会被模板化和 AI 吃掉，护城河在谈判、调解与组织判断。怕的是只做合同起草和归档的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 人力或法学打底，在校模拟谈判和学劳动法。AI 时代拼协调力，别只当文本操作员。
把 AI 起草工具用熟，补谈判和调解实战。从「写合同」升级成「管关系」，路更宽。
突出你谈过什么合同、解过什么纠纷。有谈判和合规成果优先。
招人看协调与抗压，不止看法条熟练。能独立谈能调解的专员值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 劳动法规趋严，合规与争议处理需求稳。
灵活用工增多，关系更杂更难管。
会谈判能调解的复合专员更稀缺。

body: 劳动关系专员负责集体谈判、劳动合同与规章制度管理、劳动争议调解与合规，在管理层与员工（或工会）之间协调，确保用工关系合法、稳定、可控。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把合同条款检索成清单，但「这条涨薪双方接不接」，还得人坐到谈判桌前谈。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Monitoring can be automated, but nurses still decide how to adjust care, whether to proceed, and how to communicate with patients.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 320,400 Nurse Practitioners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 448,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 128,400 jobs, with approximately 29,500 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $129,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these roles, but it will accelerate monitoring and documentation. Order review and vital-sign monitoring speed up routine work, shifting people from recording data toward assessment and decisions, procedures, communication, and complex cases. Standard recordkeeping faces displacement, while core professionals who can make decisions and perform procedures are more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Assessment and decisions: people make the judgment.
Procedure execution: people need steady hands.
Patient communication: people build trust.
Complex care: people integrate the pieces.
Accountability: people uphold the bottom line.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate monitoring and documentation, but people remain essential for assessment and procedures.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Recording data and completing forms are being replaced, not specialty-care roles. Core professionals who can make decisions and perform procedures are becoming scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong nursing foundation. Pure recordkeeping is shrinking, so develop decision-making and procedural skills early.
Advance from recordkeeping to assessment, procedures, and communication, and pursue advanced practice.
Highlight standardized training and specialty outcomes. Hospitals value consistency and specialization.
When hiring, look beyond credentials to decision-making and communication skills. Core professionals who can practice independently deserve strong institutional support.

ai_s7_trends: As monitoring assistance spreads, recordkeeping is shrinking.
Advanced practice receives greater emphasis.
Nurses who can make decisions are more sought after.

body: Nurse Practitioners, nurse-midwives, and nurse anesthetists independently or collaboratively provide specialty care including consultations, test ordering, medication management, analgesia, and childbirth, and remain responsible for outcomes and safety.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监测能自动，但怎么调、敢不敢上、病人怎么沟通，还是护士的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年执业护士在岗约 32.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 44.88 万人，净增约 12.84 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.95 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会加速监测与文书。医嘱审核与体征监测把常规提速，人从「记数据」挪向「评估决断、操作、沟通、复杂病例」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准记录的，会决断、能操作的骨干更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 评估决断：判断靠人。
操作执行：手稳靠人。
医患沟通：信任靠人。
复杂照护：拼接靠人。
责任担当：底线靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光——监测与文书被系统加速，但评估与操作还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「记数据写单」动作，不是「专科照护」的岗位。会决断、能操作的骨干，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 打好护理底子，纯记录在缩，早点练决断与操作。
从「记录」升级成「评估 + 操作 + 沟通」，争取高级实践。
突出规培与专科成果，医院看重稳和专。
选人别只看证，要看会不会决断和沟通，能独当一面的骨干值得给平台。

ai_s7_trends: 监测辅助普及，记录缩。
高级实践更被看重。
会决断的护士更抢手。

body: 执业护士、助产与麻醉护士独立或协同开展问诊、开检查、用药、镇痛与接生等专科照护，并对疗效与安全负责。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 监测能自动，但怎么调、敢不敢上、病人怎么沟通，还是护士的人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can predict risk from rating scales and organize records automatically, but when a patient's emotions surge, you still have to be the person willing to sit down and listen until they finish.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 144,500 psychiatric technicians and aides were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 173,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 28,800 jobs, with approximately 15,900 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $42,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace psychiatric technicians; this role is very difficult to automate. AI takes over desk work such as risk assessment, records management, and scale analysis, but machines cannot provide face-to-face observation, companionship, reassurance, and rehabilitation activities. Psychiatric recovery is fundamentally a person-to-person process. The tools change: AI detects risk earlier and leaves more time for companionship.
ai_s2_accel: AI behavioral monitoring to help detect abnormal states
Intelligent scales and assessment tools supporting diagnosis
Rehabilitation activity data platforms supporting personalized plans
Remote follow-up and community mental health management
ai_s2_auto: Automatic management of patient records and scale data
ai_s3_list: Face-to-face observation: cameras cannot fully read emotion, tone, and body language.
Real-time judgment in communication and reassurance: experience determines when to listen and when to comfort.
Ability to organize rehabilitation activities: getting a group moving and talking is a craft.
On-site risk response: people must know how to step in and de-escalate when emotions suddenly erupt.
A steady and warm presence: the ward's scarcest resource is someone who makes patients feel safe.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means half of the occupation's desk work is being automated. AI can assist with records, files, and scales.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. The core of psychiatric care is relationships. AI helps observe more comprehensively and reduces recordkeeping, but only people can accompany patients through emotional storms. Pure paperwork roles shrink, while communicative and supportive technicians become more valuable with AI assistance.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study nursing, mental health, or psychology, and prepare emotionally before a psychiatric internship. The field values stability and patience more than credentials; earning a nursing license broadens opportunities.
Use AI assessment tools and rehabilitation data platforms and advance toward psychotherapy or rehabilitation management. Move from executing care to assessing, organizing, and training.

Mental health services lack staff, making transitions easiest for people with nursing or psychology backgrounds. In your resume, describe patient populations, rehabilitation activities organized, and risk-response cases, and emphasize emotional stability.
Do not hire technicians solely by education; assess emotional stability and communication. Candidates who remain grounded and support patients are what psychiatric wards need most.

ai_s7_trends: As AI risk assessment and records management spread, technicians shift from writing records toward observation and companionship, making care quality central.
Growing mental health needs extend services into communities and rehabilitation, expanding community follow-up and rehabilitation roles.
Hybrid technicians who communicate well, understand psychology, and organize activities are scarce, while professional and training systems improve.

body: Psychiatric technicians and aides help patients with daily living, support rehabilitation activities, observe and record behavior, and assist with treatment and safety management under nurses and therapists, providing direct care in mental health services.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can predict risk from rating scales and organize records automatically, but when a patient's emotions surge, you still have to be the person willing to sit down and listen until they finish.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能根据量表预判风险、自动整理档案，但患者情绪上来的那一刻，愿意坐下来听他说完的那个人，还得是你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年精神科技术员与助手在岗约 14.45 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.33 万人，净增约 2.88 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.59 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代精神科技术员，这个岗位很难被替代。风险评估、档案管理、量表分析这些桌面活被 AI 接手，但面对面的观察、陪伴、安抚和康复活动，机器做不了——精神科的恢复过程，本质上是「人与人」的过程。真正被改变的是工具：AI 帮你更早发现风险，把更多时间留给陪伴。
ai_s2_accel: AI 行为监测辅助发现异常状态
智能量表与评估工具辅助诊断
康复活动数据平台支持个体化方案
远程随访与社区精神卫生管理
ai_s2_auto: 排班与病房记录电子化
患者档案与量表数据自动管理
风险评分由系统辅助计算
ai_s3_list: 面对面的观察：情绪、语气、肢体语言，机器镜头看不全。
沟通安抚的临场判断：什么时候该听、什么时候该安抚，靠经验。
康复活动的组织力：带着一群人动起来、聊起来，是门手艺。
风险处置的现场反应：情绪失控瞬间怎么上前、怎么化解，靠人。
稳定而温暖的气场：病房里最稀缺的，是让患者安心的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半桌面任务正被自动化——记录、档案、量表，AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。精神科照护的核心是「关系」，AI 帮你观察得更全面、记录得更省力，但陪着患者走过情绪风暴的，只能是人。真正被压缩的是纯文书岗，会沟通、能陪伴的技术员反而因为 AI 的加持更有价值。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选护理、精神卫生或心理相关专业，进精神科实习前先做好心理建设。这行看重的不是学历，是稳定和耐心；考下护士证路会更宽。
把 AI 评估工具和康复数据平台用起来，往心理治疗师、康复管理方向提升。从「执行照护」升级为「会评估、会组织、会培训」。
精神卫生领域缺人，护理或心理背景转行最顺。简历上多写「接触过的患者类型、组织的康复活动、风险处置案例」，并突出情绪稳定性。
招技术员别只看学历，要看情绪稳定性和沟通能力。能稳住自己、接得住患者的候选人，是精神科病房最需要的类型。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 行为数据辅助风险评分
个体化活动方案与记录

ai_s7_trends: AI 风险评估与档案管理普及，技术员从「写记录」转向「重观察、重陪伴」，照护质量成为核心。
心理健康需求增长，精神卫生服务向社区与康复延伸，社区随访与康复岗位扩容。
「会沟通、懂心理、能组织活动」的复合技术员稀缺，职业化与培训体系在完善。

body: 精神科技术员与助手负责协助精神科患者完成日常起居、参与康复活动、观察与记录行为状态，并在护士和治疗师指导下配合治疗与安全管理，是精神卫生服务体系中提供直接照。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能根据量表预判风险、自动整理档案，但患者情绪上来的那一刻，愿意坐下来听他说完的那个人，还得是你。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate submission templates, but managers still decide whether to enter the U.S. or Europe first and how to communicate with reviewers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,333,700 regulatory affairs managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1,393,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 59,800 jobs, with about 106,700 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $136,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace regulatory affairs managers, but it will redesign documentation workflows. As AI takes over regulatory searches, template generation, and progress tracking, managers shift from monitoring documents to registration strategy, agency communication, and team leadership. People who define pathways, carry risk, and lead teams remain truly scarce.
ai_s2_auto: Automated searches of regulations and guidance
Consistency checks for translations and formatting
ai_s3_list: Strategic judgment: people choose the regulatory pathway.
Agency communication: people negotiate with reviewers.
Risk tradeoffs: people carry responsibility for pace and investment.
Team leadership: people manage talent and quality.
Final accountability: people bear responsibility when problems occur.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 means this occupation has moderately high exposure in documentation. Searches and generation are heavily automated, but people retain responsibility for strategy and leadership.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Document production is being replaced, not the occupation. Managers who set strategy, communicate, and accept accountability become scarcer. Those who only compile documents mechanically and avoid strategy face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in medicine, pharmaceuticals, or law and develop RAC and English skills while studying. Strategy and communication matter in the AI era, so do not focus only on documentation.
Advance from preparing documents to setting strategy. Learn management and agency communication and pursue a manager role rather than remaining in mechanical compilation.
Highlight global submissions and team experience and specify the markets you managed. Oncology and international expansion experience are advantages.
When hiring, assess strategy and accountability, not only document volume. Managers who define pathways and accept responsibility deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: As document production becomes increasingly automated, managers shift toward strategy.
Innovative drugs and international expansion create long-term demand.
Versatile managers who understand strategy and coordination are more sought after.

body: Regulatory affairs managers develop global registration and compliance strategies, manage regulatory teams, coordinate submissions and review communications across markets, and control launch timing and regulatory risk. They are key managers connecting products with regulators.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 资料模板能交给 AI 生成，但「先攻美国还是先攻欧洲、怎么跟审评讲」，还得经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年法规事务经理在岗约 133.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 139.35 万人，净增约 5.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.67 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.65 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代法规事务经理，但会重做资料流程。法规检索、模板生成、进度跟踪交给 AI 后，经理从「盯文档」挪向「注册战略、机构沟通与团队统筹」。真正稀缺的是能定路径、扛风险、带队伍的人。
ai_s2_auto: 法规与指南的自动检索
进度与时限的自动跟踪
译文与格式的一致性检查
ai_s3_list: 策略判断：走哪条通道靠人定。
机构沟通：审评对话靠人谈。
风险取舍：节奏与投入靠人扛。
团队统筹：人与质量靠人带。
责任兜底：出事要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的资料区——检索与生成大量被自动化，但策略与统筹还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「资料生产」，不是「岗位」。会策略、能沟通、敢扛责的经理反而更稀缺。怕的是只做机械汇编、不碰战略的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医药法打底，在校把 RAC 和英语练了。AI 时代拼的是策略和沟通，别只做资料。
从「做资料」升级成「定策略」，学管理和机构沟通，争取转经理，别停留在机械汇编。
突出全球申报和团队经验，写清管过哪些市场。有肿瘤和出海优先。
招人看策略与扛责，不止看资料量。能定路径、敢担责的经理值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 资料生产不断自动化，经理转向战略。
创新药与出海长期用人。
会策略懂统筹的复合经理更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CNC machines can cut standard slabs, but stonemasons still decide how to join irregular shapes, make on-site repairs, and align the joints.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 12,100 stonemasons were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 11,800 by 2034, a net decrease of about 300 jobs, with about 800 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $52,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace stonemasons, but it will assist with material cutting. Layout software and CNC cutting accelerate standard slab work, shifting stonemasons from purely physical cutting toward irregular shapes, restoration, and on-site judgment. People who only cut standard slabs face displacement, while skilled craftspeople become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Cutting by feel: people find the angle.
Joining irregular shapes: people align the seams.
On-site restoration: people assess old stone.
Structural judgment: people ensure stability.
Decorative aesthetics: people cultivate taste.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-to-moderate AI exposure range. Standard cutting is accelerated, but people retain an essential role in masonry and restoration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is cutting standard slabs, not irregular-shape and restoration work. Skilled people with strong on-site judgment become scarcer as productivity rises. Those who only cut standard slabs face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation at vocational school and practice blueprint reading and craftsmanship. Standard slab work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop irregular-shape and restoration skills early.
Advance from slab cutting to irregular shapes plus restoration, and study historic architecture and high-end decorative work.
Highlight projects and craftsmanship and specify the types of stone you have worked with. Employers value steady, detailed work.
When hiring, look beyond strength to steady hands and blueprint reading. Core workers who can restore historic buildings deserve high daily rates.

ai_s7_trends: Prefabricated components absorb standard slab work
Demand for historic-building restoration remains steady
High-end decorative work creates opportunities

body: Stonemasons follow drawings to cut, trim, lay, and decorate natural stone. They coordinate mortar, alignment, and acceptance checks to create stable stone structures with the intended appearance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 数控能切标准板，但异形怎么拼、现场怎么修、缝怎么对，还是石匠定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年石匠在岗约 1.21 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.18 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.20 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代石匠，但会辅助下料。排版软件与数控切割把标准板材提速，石匠从「纯体力切」挪向「异形、修复、现场判断」。真正被挤掉的是只切标准板的人，有手艺的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 手感下刀：角度靠人找。
异形拼接：缝靠人对。
现场修复：旧靠人判。
结构判断：稳靠人定。
装饰审美：味靠人养。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在低中 AI 曝光区——标准切割被加速，但砌筑与修复还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「切标准板」动作，不是「异形修复」的岗位。有手艺、能现场判断的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会切标准板。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校打底多练读图与手艺，AI 时代标准板在缩，早点练异形与修复。
从「切板」升级成「异形 + 修复」，学古建与高端装饰。
突出项目与手艺，写清做过哪些石材。用工方看重稳和细。
选人别只看力气，要看手稳与读图。能修古建的骨干值得给高日薪。

ai_s7_trends: 预制构件吃标准板
古建修复需求稳
高端装饰带来机会
